digest.lead: Claude Code gets PowerShell support for Windows developers in today's v2.1.84 release, expanding the tool's reach beyond Unix environments.
digest.summary: Meanwhile, a lawyer's victory at Anthropic's recent hackathon is sparking discussion about AI applications beyond traditional tech use cases.

stories.headline: Mozilla Partners with Anthropic on Firefox Security Initiative
stories.summary: Anthropic announced a new security collaboration with Mozilla focused on Firefox browser security [1]. Details about the specific nature of the partnership remain limited in the initial announcement.
stories.impact: This partnership could signal Anthropic's expansion into browser security applications, potentially affecting Firefox users and web developers working on security-focused projects.

stories.headline: Claude Code v2.1.84 Adds PowerShell Support for Windows Developers
stories.summary: The latest Claude Code release introduces PowerShell tool support as an opt-in preview feature, marking a significant expansion for Windows developers [1]. The update also adds new environment variables for customizing third-party model configurations and streaming timeouts.
key_points: PowerShell tool now available as opt-in preview for Windows users
New environment variables allow customization of model capabilities for Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry integrations
Configurable streaming idle timeout via CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS (default 90 seconds)
stories.impact: This update significantly improves Claude Code's accessibility for Windows-based development teams and provides more flexibility for enterprise deployments using third-party model providers.

stories.headline: Lawyer's Hackathon Victory Highlights AI Applications Beyond Tech
stories.summary: A lawyer won Anthropic's recent hackathon, prompting discussion about overlooked applications of Claude in non-technical fields [1]. The Hacker News community is debating what the tech industry might be missing about AI's broader potential.
stories.impact: This win suggests legal professionals and other non-technical users may be discovering innovative Claude applications that traditional developers haven't considered, potentially opening new market opportunities.

stories.headline: Enable PowerShell tool for Windows development workflows
stories.summary: Claude Code now includes an opt-in PowerShell tool that allows Windows users to execute PowerShell commands directly through Claude. This provides native Windows command-line access for system administration and development tasks.
actionable_steps: Update Claude Code to version 2.1.84 or later
Enable the PowerShell tool in your settings as a preview feature

stories.headline: Configure streaming timeout for better connection handling
stories.summary: The new CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS environment variable lets you customize how long Claude Code waits before timing out idle streaming connections. This helps prevent unnecessary disconnections during long-running operations.
actionable_steps: Choose a timeout value in milliseconds (default is 90000 for 90 seconds)
Restart Claude Code for the setting to take effect

stories.headline: Use managed settings drop-in directory for team policy deployment
stories.summary: The new managed-settings.d/ directory allows multiple teams to deploy independent configuration fragments that automatically merge. This enables better organization of team-specific policies without conflicts.
actionable_steps: Create a managed-settings.d/ directory alongside your managed-settings.json
Place individual team policy files in the directory (they merge alphabetically)
Name files with prefixes to control merge order (e.g., 01-team-a.json, 02-team-b.json)

stories.headline: Use Claude's extended thinking for complex architectural decisions
stories.summary: When asking Claude to make non-trivial design choices — like choosing between patterns, structuring a new module, or planning a migration — enabling extended thinking produces significantly better results. Claude will reason through trade-offs before committing to an approach, catching issues that quick responses miss.
actionable_steps: For architecture questions, ask Claude to 'think through the trade-offs' explicitly
Use Claude Code's plan mode (shift+tab) for multi-step tasks that need careful reasoning
Review Claude's reasoning in extended thinking to catch flawed assumptions early

sources.title: Tips for getting better architectural advice from Claude

stories.headline: Use @-mentions to give Claude Code precise file context
stories.summary: Boris Cherny, creator of Claude Code, recommends using @-mentions to point Claude at specific files instead of letting it search. This dramatically reduces token usage and improves accuracy since Claude works with the exact files you intend rather than guessing from project structure.
actionable_steps: Type @ in Claude Code to see a file picker with fuzzy search
Select the specific files relevant to your task before writing your prompt
Combine multiple @-mentions for cross-file tasks like refactoring
